experiment: E8, how many judgments a correction needs
status: a reading added on 20 November 2026, after the results of E8 were seen: not a test
how: n presentations drawn from the validation set give the slope of the judge's cue on the frame; the test cue of the judge is corrected with it and put beside the soloist with the best linear use of the two cues. Share kept = (D_n^2 - D_1^2) / (D_all^2 - D_1^2), median over the draws; predicted from a bias left of 1 / n. Units where the gain is below 0.2 are left out
